name: sidebar-paneview
title: Sidebar PaneView: resizable collapsible sections
description: Port VS Code PaneView/SplitView model for sidebar sections (grill decision Q1-A): each section = resizable pane (fixed 22px header + independently-scrolling body), vertical drag sashes between panes, collapsed panes shrink to header + freed space distributes to expanded panes (collapsed headers pack bottom), pane sizes persist. Applies to Inspector (2 sections), Struct (2), Integrity/Scripts (1 each - fill only). Replaces the shared-scroll stacked .sb-tab-panel layout with a split-view layout inside each panel.
creator: deviousprophet
